hero.title: How Claude Code works
hero.subtitle: An agentic coding assistant that reads, writes, and executes code directly in your terminal, IDE, and GitHub workflow.
overview.title: What it is
overview.body-1: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding assistant that works directly in your codebase across terminal, IDE, web, mobile, Slack, and GitHub.
overview.body-2: It reads, writes, and executes code, runs tasks across parallel subagents, maps and explains entire codebases, and opens pull requests end-to-end without a remote code index.

capabilities.title: Key capabilities
item-1.title: Agentic multi-file editing
item-1.body: Understands and edits across an entire codebase, not just the open file.
item-2.title: Routines and scheduling
item-2.body: Runs scheduled or event-triggered tasks with no manual trigger required.
item-3.title: Fast Mode
item-3.body: A 2.5x faster Opus configuration for rapid iteration.
item-4.title: Issue-to-PR workflows
item-4.body: Reads issues, writes code, runs tests, and submits pull requests end to end.
explainer.title: Under the hood
explainer.body-1: Claude Code runs locally and talks directly to model APIs without a remote code index, which means it works with your existing toolchain instead of replacing it. IDE extensions for VS Code and JetBrains, plus GitHub Actions integration, keep it embedded in the workflow your team already uses.
quote.text: Claude Code is moving our team up a level: we decide what needs to happen, and smooth the process so it can build and verify end-to-end.
quote.author: Simon Last
explainer.body-2: Enterprise deployments add SOC 2 Type II compliance, TLS 1.3 and AES-256 encryption, and bring-your-own-key options through Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Microsoft Foundry, so code never has to leave your own VPC.
